Rotating motion naturally makes circles but getting a mechanism to draw sharp 90° corners from a spinning motor is a bit more complicated. The secret is a sliding connector link driven by the motor, paired with an elastic that pushes the carriage on an x-y gantry to its extremes. The elastic is what forces the sharp corners instead of rounding them off. I Designed the whole thing in @SolidWorks, including a latch system that drops the pen down when you're ready to draw.
